evaluation.decision: At primary confidence 0.13 prioritize supported missed-object recovery, recording every gained/lost identity and all extra/corner/empty-scene tradeoffs. A gain only among uncertain reference rows or a changed assignment does not establish physically supported recovery. Before any separate promotion decision, require supported additional recovery without losing previously supported matches or existing 5/10 px pair successes, and without adding empty-scene detections. Inspect every newly added proposal and report review workload. Retain the current PR35 workflow otherwise. No automatic promotion or threshold/seed/epoch search.

limits: One matched pair for the frozen PR45 fourteen-box candidate; no search over seeds, epochs, thresholds or alternative annotation subsets.

Both roles retain the same YOLO-Pose architecture, cassette_front class and two actual lower-front corner slots. This study retains the observed-front policy; it does not infer hidden/full-object boxes, missing corners or physical dimensions.
